subtitle: Out Manila · China Southern Airlines
overview: Fly China Southern via Guangzhou to Yichang, cruise through Xiling Gorge past the Gezhouba Dam, then visit the Three Gorges Waterfall and the Water Town in Dream before moving on to Wuhan for East Lake, Jianghan Road and the Sky Train. You stay in 4-star hotels. This is a No Shopping package.
travelDatesNote: Departures from Manila, Nov 24–29 2026 to Nov 24–29 2026. The rate changes by date: an amount on a date is added to the base rate per pax. Seats are limited and confirmed at booking.

itinerary.title: Manila – Guangzhou – Yichang
items: Fly Manila to Guangzhou (CZ3092, 12:00–14:40), then Guangzhou to Yichang (CZ3311, 21:30–23:15)
Arrive in Yichang and meet the English-speaking tour guide
Drive to hotel and check in

itinerary.title: Yichang
items: Hotel breakfast
Cruise through Xiling Gorge and past the Gezhouba Dam
Golden autumn scenery along the Yichang Binjiang River
Yichang CBD Night Market
Three Gorges Dam, the world’s largest inland waterway project, with shuttle bus (optional)

itinerary.title: Yichang – Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast and check out
Three Gorges Waterfall (scenic area transportation included)
Water Town in Dream (boat tour included)
Transfer to Wuhan
After dinner, hotel check in

itinerary.title: Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast
Sky Train experience
East Lake Scenic Area (looking for migratory birds)
Wuchang Bay + Douji Camp
Jianghan Road, a century-old road
Wushang Dream Plaza, the world’s largest indoor commercial complex
AI robot + snow park entertainment, cotton clothing included (optional)

itinerary.title: Wuhan
items: Hotel breakfast
Anshan Mountain or Qinglongshan Forest Park
Ginkgo Avenue on Canglong Island
Xiaozhu Bay (autumn countryside scenery)
Popular photo spots: Jianghan Customs, Lihuangpi Road, Bagong House, Riverside Autumn Garden
Large-scale Han-style performance: high-tech water show + traditional Chinese acrobatics (optional)

itinerary.title: Wuhan – Guangzhou – Manila
items: Hotel or packed breakfast and check out
Transfer to the airport and fly Wuhan to Guangzhou (CZ6590, 09:30–11:30)
Connecting flight Guangzhou to Manila (CZ397, 14:15–16:50)

placeDesc.Xiling Gorge: One of the three famous gorges of the Yangtze, cruised on this tour.
placeDesc.Gezhouba Dam: A large dam and ship lock on the Yangtze at Yichang, passed on the river cruise.
placeDesc.Yichang CBD Night Market: A night market in Yichang's central business district with food and souvenir stalls.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Dam: The huge dam on the Yangtze, the world's largest inland waterway project; an optional visit with shuttle bus.
placeDesc.Three Gorges Waterfall: A waterfall scenic area in the Yichang area; scenic area transportation is included.
placeDesc.Water Town in Dream: A water-town style scenic area near Yichang with a boat tour included.
placeDesc.Wuhan Sky Train: A suspended sky train ride in Wuhan with city and lake views.
placeDesc.East Lake Scenic Area: One of China's largest urban lakes, in Wuhan, visited for its migratory birds.
placeDesc.Wuchang Bay: A lakeside scenic area in Wuhan, visited with Douji Camp for the autumn colours.
placeDesc.Jianghan Road: A century-old shopping street in central Wuhan.
placeDesc.Wushang Dream Plaza: A huge indoor commercial complex in Wuhan, described as the world's largest of its kind.
placeDesc.Anshan Mountain: A mountain park near Wuhan, an alternative stop to Qinglongshan Forest Park.
placeDesc.Qinglongshan Forest Park: A forest park near Wuhan visited on Day 5 (or Anshan Mountain).
placeDesc.Canglong Island Ginkgo Avenue: An avenue of ginkgo trees on Canglong Island, known for golden autumn leaves.
placeDesc.Xiaozhu Bay: A countryside area near Wuhan visited for its autumn scenery.
